name: Death House (Durst Manor)
subtitle: Curse of Strahd • Levels 1-3 Starter Dungeon
description: A four-story townhouse with a sinister past and a hidden sub-basement cult undercroft beneath the cobblestones.

nodes.name: Entrance Hall
nodes.boxedText: A wrought-iron gate with trefoils leads into an arched entrance hall. The walls are paneled in dark wood carved with weeping angels, twisting ivy, and coiled serpents. A heavy, iron-bound oak door stands at the far end.
nodes.atmosphere: Drafty mountain air, scent of ancient furniture wax and dried lavender.
features: Intricately carved mahogany paneling depicting cherubs and weeping angels.
Durst family heraldic shield on wall: a golden windmill on a field of black sable.

secrets.text: Close examination reveals disturbing details in the carvings: the weeping angels have serpents in their eye sockets, and innocent cherubs are choking on thorned vines.

nodes.name: Main Hall
nodes.boxedText: A wide hall with a black-and-white checkerboard marble floor opens before you. A grand mahogany staircase curves upward with sculpted railings. A tall grandfather clock in the corner ticks with a hollow, rhythmic cadence.
nodes.lighting: Dim light filtering through fogged bay windows
nodes.atmosphere: The rhythmic, heavy tick-tock of the tall grandfather clock echoes through the empty mansion.
features: Grand sweeping staircase ascending to the second floor.
A brass grandfather clock that is meticulously wound and keeps exact Barovian time.

secrets.text: The clock mechanism is pristine and ticking despite decades of thick dust on every other surface in the foyer.

nodes.name: Den of Wolves
nodes.boxedText: This oak-paneled den is decorated with the trophies of a dedicated hunter. Mounted wolves' heads stare with glass eyes from the walls, and a large taxidermied dire wolf stands snarling on a pedestal. An unlit stone hearth anchors the far wall.
nodes.atmosphere: Smell of old animal hide, turpentine, and dry ash.
features: Mounted heads of seven mountain wolves and one enormous dire wolf.
Comfortable high-backed leather armchairs beside a stone hearth.

secrets.text: A secret button hidden behind the mounted dire wolf's ear slides open a concealed panel in the oak mantelpiece, holding a silver hip flask of dwarven brandy (worth 25 gp).

loot.name: Silver Hip Flask of Dwarven Brandy
loot.notes: Worth 25 gp, contains 4 sips of potent warming spirit

nodes.name: Kitchen & Pantry
nodes.boxedText: A tidy kitchen features a high ceiling with iron hooks for smoked meats, now empty. A cold stone hearth with an iron spit dominates one wall. A small dumbwaiter shaft with heavy hemp rope is built into the corner wall.
nodes.atmosphere: Faint sour odor of vinegar and rotten flour.
features: Worktables scrubbed spotless with dried cleavers and carving knives.
Dumbwaiter shaft connecting directly to the second-floor library and third-floor master suite.

secrets.text: A Small creature can squeeze inside the dumbwaiter box to travel between floors.

nodes.name: Dining Room
nodes.boxedText: In the center of this stately room, a mahogany dining table is surrounded by eight high-backed chairs. A crystal chandelier hangs overhead, coated in spiderwebs. The wall paneling depicts feast scenes that turn subtly into cannibalistic depravity.
nodes.atmosphere: Chilly and still.
features: Resplendent crystal chandelier hanging from a central ceiling medallion.
Silverware set for eight guests, polished to a dull shine.

secrets.text: The carved scenes in the paneling show noble men and women smiling warmly while drinking chalices filled with what appears to be human blood.

loot.name: Fine Silver Tableware Set
loot.notes: Worth 50 gp total, stamped with Durst windmill crest

nodes.name: Upper Hall
nodes.boxedText: Unlit oil lamps hang from red velvet-papered walls. Mounted oil paintings depict stern Durst ancestors whose painted eyes seem to judge every step. The mahogany staircase continues upward toward a dark third floor.
nodes.atmosphere: Soft creaking timber and heavy oppressive stillness.
features: Portrait gallery of Gustav and Elisabeth Durst posing proudly with their infant child.
Balcony overlook looking down onto Area 2 Main Hall.

nodes.name: Servants' Stair
nodes.boxedText: A narrow, steep spiral wooden staircase ascends without risers in the damp darkness between floors, intended for quiet servant movement.
nodes.atmosphere: Musty, cramped, smelling of raw timber.
features: Tight wooden spiral staircase connecting Kitchen (Area 4), Second Floor, and Attic (Area 13).

nodes.name: Library & Secret Room
nodes.boxedText: Floor-to-ceiling mahogany bookshelves line this solemn library. A heavy oak desk sits facing a stone hearth with an iron fire poker. The titles on the shelves treat of dark rituals, necromancy, and ancient bloodlines.
nodes.atmosphere: Heavy smell of leather bindings and decaying parchment.
features: Hundreds of tomes covering history, demonology, and alchemy.
Locked iron desk drawer holding a key with a feather motif.

secrets.text: Pulling a false volume entitled 'The King in Golden Raiment' on the north shelf swings open a secret door into a hidden walk-in archive room.

loot.name: Letter from Strahd von Zarovich
loot.notes: Handout: Strahd dismissing Gustav's cult as pathetic worms

nodes.name: Conservatory
nodes.boxedText: Gauzy white dust covers drape over a standing harp and an ivory-keyed harpsichord. A tall arched stained-glass window looks out into the dreary Barovian mist.
nodes.atmosphere: A single note resonates faintly from the harp when the door opens.
features: Ornate standing harp carved with weeping dryads.
Harpsichord with yellowed ivory keys.

secrets.text: Playing a minor chord on the harpsichord reveals a secret velvet-lined compartment inside the soundboard containing a Potion of Climbing.

loot.name: Potion of Climbing
loot.notes: Clear brown liquid with white sediment

nodes.name: Balcony & Animated Armor
nodes.boxedText: A wooden balcony wraps around the grand stairwell, thirty feet above the ground floor. In an arched alcove at the center stands an imposing suit of blackened plate armor adorned with wolf-head pauldrons, gripping a greatsword.
nodes.atmosphere: A chill draft sighs along the balcony.
features: Blackened iron plate armor that stirs with unnatural malice when anyone approaches within 5 feet.
Two flying broadswords hovering in the upper shadows.

secrets.text: The armor radiates abjuration and transmutation magic—it is an Animated Armor primed to push trespassers off the balcony.

traps.name: Balcony Plunge Hazard
traps.trigger: Armor attempts to shove targets over the 30-ft railing
traps.effect: 3d6 bludgeoning falling damage and prone in Area 2

encounters.name: 19. Death House: The Animated Armor of the Balcony

nodes.name: Master Suite
nodes.boxedText: A grand mahogany four-poster bed is draped in moth-eaten gossamer lace. An alabaster fireplace sits cold across from a vanity table with an oval glass mirror framed in carved ivy.
nodes.atmosphere: Stale air of perfume gone sour.
features: Silk-lined jewelry box on vanity with a silver comb and garnet ring.
Adjoining door to Area 12 Nursery.

secrets.text: In the wardrobe, behind heavy winter furs, is a secret compartment holding a velvet pouch with 40 gp and 100 sp.

nodes.name: Nursery & Nursemaid's Specter
nodes.boxedText: A crib draped in black netting sits in the center of the nursery. Beside it is a rocking chair that rocks gently of its own accord. A translucent figure of a young weeping woman rises from the shadows, her spectral face contorting into an agonized shriek!
nodes.atmosphere: The spectral temperature plummets below freezing. Breath fogs instantly.
features: Empty crib with bundled blankets (no baby inside).
Weeping specter of the Nursemaid who was murdered after giving birth to Gustav's bastard child Walter.

secrets.text: The specter shrieks 'My baby! Where is my Walter?!' and attacks furiously if anyone touches the crib.

nodes.name: Servants' Quarters
nodes.boxedText: Sparse wooden bunks with moldering straw mattresses crowd this uninsulated attic corner. Rain patters against bare rafters.
nodes.atmosphere: Smell of damp wool, straw, and mice droppings.
features: Storage trunks with plain wool cloaks and servant uniforms.

nodes.name: Children's Bedroom (Rose & Thorn)
nodes.boxedText: The heavy door is padlocked from the outside. Inside, small twin beds are covered in dust. Sitting on the floor among wooden toys are two ghostly children holding hands: ten-year-old Rosavalda and seven-year-old Thornboldt, crying softly in the dark.
nodes.lighting: Ethereal translucent blue-gray glow from the ghosts
nodes.atmosphere: Profound sadness, faint smell of cedar and childhood tears.
features: Skeletons of Rose and Thorn curled under the bedsheets (locked in by their parents and starved to death).
An exquisite dollhouse at the foot of the bed that is a perfect replica of the manor.

secrets.text: Examining the dollhouse reveals a hidden trapdoor in the attic storage room that opens to a secret spiral stone staircase leading hundreds of feet beneath the mansion.

encounters.name: Ghosts of Rose and Thorn (Roleplay / Possession Hazard)

nodes.name: Attic Storage & Secret Spiral Stair
nodes.boxedText: Cobweb-strewn furniture and wooden crates fill this dead-end attic storage space. Behind an oak armoire lies a hidden flagstone trapdoor that lifts to reveal a narrow stone spiral staircase spiraling down into pitch-black subterranean depths.
nodes.atmosphere: A cold, damp breeze smelling of earth, decay, and stagnant water blows up from below.
features: Flagstone trapdoor leading into the subterranean Cult Undercroft.
Narrow spiral stone staircase descending 40 feet into ancient soil.

nodes.name: Cultist Quarters
nodes.boxedText: The spiral staircase terminates in a damp earthen basement. Clay jugs, rotting straw pallets, and moldy black cultist robes line the low-ceilinged earthen passages.
nodes.atmosphere: Faint, distant rhythmic chanting resonates through the stone floor: 'He is the Ancient. He is the Land.'
features: Dozens of discarded black ceremonial robes with cowls.
Uneven earthen floors with pooling muddy water.

nodes.name: Durst Family Crypts
nodes.boxedText: Four stone vaults are carved into the damp earth, their lintels inscribed in Barovian script: 'Gustav Durst', 'Elisabeth Durst', 'Rosavalda Durst', and 'Thornboldt Durst'. Four ghouls claw their way up from the damp graves!
nodes.atmosphere: Sickening stench of rotting flesh.
features: Four family burial niches. Rose and Thorn's crypts are empty (their skeletons still lie in the attic).
Ghouls waiting to ambush any who enter.

secrets.text: Laying the children's skeletons to rest in their proper crypts grants the party a Blessing of Inspiration.

encounters.name: 2. Death House: Crypts of the Cult

nodes.name: Relic Shrine of Dark Powers
nodes.boxedText: Stone niches around this octagonal shrine hold gruesome cult relics: shriveled mummified frogs, small bones, and dried organs. In the center stands a carved wooden statue of Count Strahd von Zarovich draped in a black cloak, holding an ominous smoky crystal orb. Four shadowy silhouettes rise from the corners!
nodes.atmosphere: The shadows whisper blasphemous syllables in chorus.
features: Life-sized wooden effigy of Strahd holding an Orb of Dark Power.
Four shadows detach from the stone wall when the orb is touched.

secrets.text: The crystal orb in Strahd's hand is an arcane focus worth 25 gp, but touching it immediately animates the 4 shadows.

encounters.name: 20. Death House: Shadows in the Dark Shrine

nodes.name: Hidden Prison & Torture Pit
nodes.boxedText: Rusted iron shackles and chains hang from the damp stone walls. Two skeletons in tattered rags are suspended over a 10-foot-deep pit with sharpened wooden stakes set into the bottom.
nodes.atmosphere: Chilling scent of dried blood and iron rust.
features: Spiked pit trap spanning the doorway to the ritual chamber.

secrets.text: The wooden floorboards over the pit are rotted through and give way under more than 50 lbs of weight.

traps.name: Spiked Pit Trap
traps.trigger: Stepping on weakened planks without testing

loot.name: Gold Ring of the Prisoner
loot.notes: Worth 15 gp, engraved with an unreadable crest

nodes.name: Ritual Chamber & Flesh Mound Altar
nodes.boxedText: The earthen passage opens into a cavernous vaulted chamber. Stagnant knee-deep water sloshes beneath your boots. In the center rises a stone dais crowned by a blood-slick sacrificial altar. Thirteen hooded spectral cultists appear on alcoves chanting in unison: 'One must die! One must die!' From a mound of rotting refuse and bone at the rear, a towering horror of decomposing flesh awakens!
nodes.lighting: Flickering spectral green flames on five stone torches
nodes.atmosphere: Deafening rhythmic cult chant: 'One must die! One must die!' and putrid reek of decaying flesh.
features: Sacrificial altar on central stone dais (requires a living sacrifice or Lorghoth awakens).
The Shambling Mound (Walter the Decayer) surges forth from the refuse pile if no sacrifice is made.

secrets.text: Slaughtering any living creature—even a rat—upon the altar satisfies the cult and grants safe egress without combat.

traps.name: Escape Gauntlet / Poison Smoke
traps.trigger: Triggered when Lorghoth is defeated or altar refused
traps.effect: House awakens into a deathtrap of scything blades and black choking smoke

encounters.name: 1. Death House: Walter the Shambling Mound

loot.name: Cloak of Protection
loot.notes: Hidden in cult trunk behind altar

name: Castle Ravenloft: Key Spire & Catacombs
subtitle: Curse of Strahd • Iconic Spires, Crypts & Audience Halls
description: The terrifying gothic fortress of Count Strahd von Zarovich perched upon a thousand-foot stone pillar above the Svalich Woods.

nodes.name: Front Courtyard & Drawbridge
nodes.boxedText: A chilling wind howls across the thousand-foot chasm. The ancient wooden drawbridge groans underfoot, leading to a massive iron portcullis. Two arched towers flank the gateway, their stone gargoyles leering through the driving mist.
nodes.atmosphere: Howling mountain winds and the rumble of distant thunder.
features: 1,000-foot drop into the foggy abyss of the pillar of stone.

nodes.name: Entry Pavilion
nodes.boxedText: Heavy bronze-reinforced oak doors swing inward soundlessly. Beyond lies a grand vestibule where cold air sweeps past stone dragons whose eyes follow your steps.
nodes.atmosphere: Uncanny silence broken only by the sound of boots on flagstones.
features: Twin bronze dragons flanking the main entry portal.

nodes.name: Great Entry Hall
nodes.boxedText: Swept gothic arches soar thirty feet overhead in this vast hall. Eight stone gargoyles cling to the ceiling vaults. Cold red rugs lead toward double doors from which the distant sound of somber organ music drifts.
nodes.lighting: Candelabras flickering with cold pale flames
nodes.atmosphere: Haunting, melancholic pipe organ melody echoing through the halls.
features: Eight gargoyles perched high on stone corbels.

secrets.text: Four of the gargoyles are carved stone, but four are living monstrosities waiting for Strahd's command.

exits.label: K10 Dining Hall of the Count

nodes.name: Dining Hall of the Count
nodes.boxedText: A blazing fire roars in an ornate hearth beneath a magnificent crystal chandelier. At the far end of an elongated dining table piled high with roast meats and decanters of red wine, an illusion of Count Strahd von Zarovich sits playing a solitary game of chess.
nodes.lighting: Warm, roaring fireplace and crystal chandelier
nodes.atmosphere: Delicious scent of roast lamb and aged wine masking a faint undercurrent of embalming spices.
features: Illusion of Strahd that speaks graciously, welcoming the party to dinner.
Grand feast set with gold chalices and silver platters.

secrets.text: Strahd's image is a projected phantasm; his voice echoes from unseen speakers in the chimney masonry.

nodes.name: The Chapel of Ravenloft
nodes.boxedText: Shattered stained-glass windows show shards of the Morninglord's solar halo. Behind a desecrated marble altar stands a bronze statue of Saint Andral, weep marks stained down its face. The shadows here feel heavy and defiant.
nodes.atmosphere: Heavy chill, holy sanctuary aura resisting the surrounding vampiric curse.
features: Desecrated altar of the Morninglord where the Icon of Ravenkind may be discovered.

secrets.text: Beneath the fallen altar stone is an intact secret compartment protected by a holy glyph.

loot.name: Icon of Ravenkind (Possible Fated Relic)
loot.notes: Holy platinum idol of a raven with ruby eyes

nodes.name: High Tower Stair & Heart of Sorrow
nodes.boxedText: A dizzying circular stone stairway spirals up into the clouds inside a hollow tower. Suspended in the void by iron struts is a ten-foot-tall, faceted crystal heart that pulses with a deep crimson rhythm: thump... thump... thump...
nodes.lighting: Throbbing crimson pulse from the crystal Heart of Sorrow
nodes.atmosphere: Deep subterranean vibration that shakes the teeth in your jaw.
features: The Heart of Sorrow: absorbs the first 50 HP of damage dealt to Count Strahd von Zarovich.
Defended by 4 animated halberds and Strahd's flying armor.

secrets.text: Destroying the Heart (HP 50, AC 15) severs Strahd's damage ward and deals him intense psychic agony.

encounters.name: 31. Castle Ravenloft: The Heart of Sorrow

nodes.name: Audience Hall & Spectral Organ
nodes.boxedText: A massive pipe organ built of bone-inlaid silver dominates the northern wall, its keys depressing as if played by invisible master fingers. Above sits a high throne carved from black marble.
nodes.atmosphere: Thunderous chords of Bach and gothic funeral dirges vibrating through the stone.
features: Autonomous spectral organ playing haunting dirges.

secrets.text: Behind the bass organ pipes is a secret latch opening a slide tube down to the catacombs.

exits.label: K10 Dining Hall of the Count

nodes.name: Count Strahd's Study & The Tome
nodes.boxedText: A cozy, book-lined study warmed by a gentle hearth. Above the mantel hangs an oil portrait of an exquisite auburn-haired maiden labeled 'Tatyana'. Upon an oak pedestal lies a heavy, leather-bound grimoire sealed with an iron latch.
nodes.atmosphere: The scent of cedar, old paper, and sweet dried rose petals.
features: Oil portrait of Tatyana Federovna (identical to Ireena Kolyana).
The Tome of Strahd resting on the central lectern.

secrets.text: The Tome contains Strahd's personal chronicle of Sergei's murder and the pact made with the Dark Powers.

loot.name: The Tome of Strahd (Fated Relic)
loot.notes: Reveals Strahd's history, flaws, and vulnerabilities

nodes.name: The Treasury of Ravenloft
nodes.boxedText: Behind a massive adamantine vault door with three keyholes lies Strahd's personal treasury. Piles of mint electrum, platinum crowns, and crystal decanters glitter in the darkness.
nodes.atmosphere: The metallic scent of hoard gold and ancient wards.
features: Three complex mechanical locks (DC 20 each to pick).

traps.name: Shadow Ward Trap
traps.trigger: Failing to disarm the vault locks triggers a blast of negative energy
traps.effect: 4d10 necrotic damage on a failed DC 15 Con save

loot.name: The Sunsword (Fated Relic)
loot.notes: Hilt of living sunlight (if placed here by Tarokka)

nodes.name: Dungeon Cells & Rahadin's Post
nodes.boxedText: Iron cages hang by chains over stagnant green water. From the shadows steps Rahadin, Strahd's dusk elf chamberlain, as the agonizing psychic screams of thousands of slaughtered innocents fill your mind!
nodes.lighting: Dying torches in iron wall sconces
nodes.atmosphere: The Deathly Choir: the psychic screams of Rahadin's victims echo in the mind of everyone within 30 feet.
features: Water-filled cells holding captive prisoners (including Emil the werewolf).

nodes.name: The Grand Catacombs
nodes.boxedText: A vast underground labyrinth of stone crypts stretches into darkness. Thick white fog covers the stone floor to a depth of three feet. Stone pillars support soaring archways carved with names of ancestors, warlords, and forgotten consorts.
nodes.lighting: Pitch blackness • White rolling mist floor
nodes.atmosphere: Deathly cold, total silence, smell of dry bones and ancient lime.
features: Forty crypts carved into the stone.
Swarming bats clinging to the high vaulted ceiling.

secrets.text: Following the tracks through the fog floor leads straight to the crypts of Sergei, Barov, and the Dark Master.

nodes.name: Tomb of Sergei von Zarovich
nodes.boxedText: Inside this crypt rests a coffin of pure crystal that radiates a soft, holy golden luminescence. Within lies the uncorrupted body of a handsome young man in polished silver armor.
nodes.lighting: Holy golden light radiating from the crystal coffin
nodes.atmosphere: Pure peaceful silence defying the dark evil of the castle.
features: The uncorrupted remains of Prince Sergei von Zarovich.

nodes.name: Tomb of Barov and Ravenovia
nodes.boxedText: Two massive sarcophagi of polished black marble stand side by side, bearing the carved likenesses of King Barov and Queen Ravenovia.
nodes.atmosphere: Heavy ancestral gloom.
features: The sarcophagi of Strahd's parents for whom the valley and castle were named.

nodes.name: Tomb of Patrina Velikovna
nodes.boxedText: Rotting funeral lace spills from a stone coffin. From the darkness rises the shrieking banshee of Patrina Velikovna, the dusk elf mage stoned by her people for daring to marry Strahd!
nodes.atmosphere: Wailing wind of unfulfilled hatred.
features: The banshee spirit of Patrina.

nodes.name: Tomb of Count Strahd von Zarovich
nodes.boxedText: The air in this vault is colder than the grave. In the center sits a polished black marble bier bearing a single coffin of ancient dark wood, carved with the single word: 'STRAHD'. Upon the bier stands Count Strahd von Zarovich, his red eyes burning with eternal wrath!
nodes.atmosphere: Oppressive supernatural majesty and deadly terror. The master is here.
features: Strahd's true earth coffin where he regenerates if reduced to 0 HP.
Three vampire brides lurking on the high walls above.

secrets.text: Soil from his homeland of Barovia fills the bottom of the coffin.

encounters.name: 18. Castle Ravenloft: Climax with the Master

loot.name: Lord Strahd's Crested Signet Ring
loot.notes: Master key to all locks in Castle Ravenloft
